simple.meaning: to fail ; by implication to wear out , decay (causatively, consume , spend )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בָּלָה (H1086) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 16 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בָּלָה (bâlâh) means to fail ; by implication to wear out , decay (causatively, consume , spend ) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 17 9.

definitions.short: to fail ; by implication to wear out , decay (causatively, consume , spend )
definitions.usage: consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.
definitions.full: H1086. balah [ בָּלָה ] verb become old and worn out (Arabic , Aramaic בְּלֵי , , Ethiopic id. ) — Qal Perfect בָּלְתָה Deut 8:4 , בָּלוּ 29:4 +; Imperfect יִבְלֶה Job 13:28 etc.; Infinitive with suffix בְּלֹתִי Gen 18:12 ; — wear out (intransitive), especially of garments Deut 8:4 ; 29:4 (twice in verse), all with מֵעַל pregnantly wear out (and fall) from upon... (hence Neh 9:21 ), Josh 9:13 ; figurative of the heavens (with simile of garment) Isa 50:9 ; Psa 102:27 יִבְלוּ כַּבֶּגֶד , the earth Isa 51:6 תִּבְלֶה כַּבֶּגֶד ; the bones (through suffering) Psa 32:3 ; afflicted man Job 13:28 יִבְלֶה כְּרָקָב וְהוּא (|| עָשׁ אֲכָלוֺ כְּבֶגֶד ); of an aged and decrepit woman Gen 18:12 (J) בְלֹתִי אַחֲרֵי after I am worn out. Pi`el causative of Qal. a. wear out (transitive), figurative Lam 3:4 וְעוֺרִי בְשָׂרִי בִּלָּה , Psa 49:15 and their form שְּׁאוֺל לְבַלּוֺת is for Sh®°ôl to consume away (others read לִבְלוֺת is for wasting away [Dr § 204 ], connecting ׳שׁ with following), 1Chr 17:9 לְבַלֹּתוֺ to wear it (Israel) out (altered from לְעַנּוֺתוֺ 2Sam 7:10 ), compare Dan 7:25 Aramaic b. wear out by use, use to the full , Isa 65:22 and the work of their hands יְבַלּוּ they shall use to the full, enjoy , Job 21:13 they wear out their days in prosperity (Qr here יְכַלּוּ complete , which perhaps is the true reading in both passages; compare Exod 5:13 ; Job 36:11 ). — On ַבּלּוֺתֹּי Psa 92:11 , see below בָּלַל .
